title: 第23章 仙学聊斋第24章 正气破邪
content_zh:
残月下，废弃丹房的蛛网被阴气搅得晃动。
黑衣身影背对着门口，指尖捏着一道黑色符咒，符箓贴在女鬼眉心，疼得她魂体扭曲，发出细碎的呜咽。
“废物！”邪修声音嘶哑，带着压抑的怒火，“让你去搅扰那几个有希望夺仙籍名额的，吸取阳气，废其修为，让其元气大伤。
到时候，他们参加不了仙籍道考，不敢出来见人，必不敢声张自身的丑事。可没让你下死手！现在仙师查得紧，你想坏了我的仙籍大事？”
女鬼长发散乱，红裙上沾着若有若无的黑气，哭喊道：“不是我要杀他！那吴燃灯屋里有正气符咒，伤了我的魂体，若不及时吸阳气，我魂魄就要散了……”
邪修闻言，转过身来，兜帽下的目光阴鸷：“吴燃灯？倒是小看了这届首席新生。
本来只是想顺手打压一下这个新生首席，让其对仙籍不再妄想。没想到恰恰是此人，坏了我的好事。
他炼出浩然正气，专克阴气邪气。白日我以画皮之术遮掩气机逃过一劫，若是对上此人，我也难免露馅！必须先解决此人才行！”
他沉吟片刻，从怀中摸出一张薄如蝉翼的皮纸，软面弹性，上面泛着人皮一般的诡异光泽，“这是美人画皮，你披上它，化作貌美女弟子模样，再去探他的底细。
若能找到机会，就一不做二不休。既然已经杀了一人，就不在乎多杀一个。”
他顿了顿，指尖划过一道黑芒。
女鬼接过画皮，往身上这么一披，瞬间化作一层肌肤般的薄膜裹住她。
红影褪去，原地就化作了一个前凸后翘的貌美女子，身穿白纱，肌肤若雪，若隐若现，
“去吧。”邪修挥了挥手，重新隐入阴影中，“记住，再出纰漏，我便让你魂飞魄散。”
画皮后的女鬼眼中闪过一丝恐惧，转身悄无声息地飘了出去，朝着吴燃灯的住处而去。
月色落在她身上，映出的影子却带着几分扭曲的虚浮，仿佛随时会被风吹散。
烛火摇曳，映得案上的《符箓》字迹忽明忽暗，吴燃灯埋头沉浸其中，属性上进度缓慢提升。
窗外传来女子的笑声，如银铃坠玉，带着几分娇憨。
“谁？”吴燃灯抬眼，目光扫过窗纸上映出的窈窕身影。
“师弟，我是小芊，是往届的学子，”女声柔婉，带着笑意，“久闻吴师弟符法精妙，今夜特来请教一二。”

“哦？”吴燃灯嘴角勾出一丝笑容，放下书卷，起身透过窗子向外望去。
门外立着个女子，绿裙及地，眉眼如画，肌肤在月光下泛着莹润的光泽，青春里藏着若有似无的勾人意味。
“原来是小芊师姐，贵客上门，请进！”见此绝世美色，吴燃灯立刻目眩神迷，一脸殷勤，侧身引她入内，眼底却掠过一丝冷光。
方才开门瞬间，他分明嗅到了一缕极淡的、与前夜女鬼同源的阴腥气，只是被脂粉香盖过了大半。
小芊款款走入，目光在屋内扫过，见满墙书卷，故作惊讶：“师弟读书果然勤勉，只是……夜深人静，一个人看书，不觉得无趣么？”
她说着，指尖轻轻拂过案上的符纸，指甲涂着蔻丹，泛着妖冶的红。
吴燃灯忙着沏茶，嘴角噙着笑：“有学姐这样的美人来访，红袖添香，怎么会无趣呢？”
小芊心中冷笑，暗自得意，男人没有好东西，全都是色中饿鬼。
男人都是这样，表面道貌岸然，其实都是见色起意。
这吴燃灯看似一身正气，原来也过不了美人关。
她垂眸掩住眼底的讥诮，声音愈发柔媚：“师弟过奖了，我这有个符法上的难题，想请教师弟……”
小芊走近几步，衣袖拂过吴燃灯的手臂，带着一丝刻意的冰凉。
吴燃灯似被吸引，抬头望她，目光“痴迷”，手中的茶壶却悄悄往茶杯里多注了些热水，水汽氤氲，模糊了他眼底一闪而过的清明。
“学姐请讲，”他笑得愈发“殷勤”，“只要我懂的，定当知无不言。”
content_en:
Under the waning moon, the cobwebs in the abandoned alchemy room were swayed by the Yin Qi.
The figure in black turned his back to the door, holding a black talisman between his fingertips. The talisman was placed between the female ghost's eyebrows, causing her soul to twist in pain and let out a thin whimper.
"Trash!" The evil cultivator's voice was hoarse, with suppressed anger, "I want you to disturb those few who have the hope of winning the immortal status, absorb the yang energy, destroy their cultivation, and severely damage their vitality.
When the time comes, they will not be able to take the Immortal Book Examination, they will not dare to come out to meet others, and they will certainly not dare to publicize their own scandals. I didn’t ask you to kill me! Now the Immortal Master is investigating closely. Do you want to ruin my important immortality? "
The female ghost's long hair was messy, and her red skirt was stained with a vague black energy. She cried: "It's not me who wants to kill him! There is a righteousness charm in Wu Randen's house, which hurts my soul. If I don't absorb the yang energy in time, my soul will be scattered..."
Hearing this, Xie Cultivator turned around, his eyes under the hood were sinister: "Wu Randeng? You have underestimated this chief freshman.
Originally, I just wanted to suppress the new chief to stop his delusions about immortality. Unexpectedly, it was this person who ruined my good deeds.
He cultivated the awe-inspiring righteousness and specialized in overcoming the evil yin energy. During the day, I used the art of skin painting to hide my energy and escaped disaster. If I were to face this person, I would inevitably reveal my secret! This person must be solved first! "
He pondered for a moment and took out a piece of leather paper as thin as a cicada's wing from his arms. It was soft and elastic, with a strange luster like human skin, "This is the beauty's painted skin. You put it on and transform into a beautiful disciple, and then go find out his true identity."
If you can find an opportunity, you will never stop doing it. Since I have already killed one person, I don’t care about killing one more. "
He paused, and a black light flashed across his fingertips.
The female ghost took the painting and put it on her body, and it instantly turned into a skin-like film to wrap around her.
The red shadow faded away, and the place turned into a beautiful woman with bulging front and back, wearing a white gauze, her skin was like snow, looming,
"Go." The evil cultivator waved his hand and disappeared into the shadows again, "Remember, if you make any mistakes again, I will make your soul fly away."
A trace of fear flashed in the eyes of the female ghost behind the painted skin, she turned around and floated out quietly, heading towards Wu Randeng's residence.
The moonlight fell on her body, but the shadow reflected was a bit distorted and frivolous, as if it would be blown away by the wind at any time.
The candlelight flickered, reflecting the writing on the "Fu Lu" on the case that flickered brightly and dimly. Wu Randeng was immersed in it, and his attributes were slowly improving.
A woman's laughter came from outside the window, like silver bells and jade, with a bit of coquettishness.
"Who?" Wu Randeng raised his eyes and glanced at the slim figure reflected in the window paper.
"Junior brother, I am Xiaoqian, a former student," the female voice said softly and with a smile, "Junior brother Wu has heard about his exquisite talismans for a long time, so I came here tonight to ask for advice."
"Oh?" Wu Randeng put a smile on his lips, put down the book, stood up and looked out through the window.
Standing outside the door was a woman with a green skirt that reached the floor. Her eyebrows were picturesque, and her skin was glowing in the moonlight. There was a hint of seductiveness hidden in her youth.
"It turns out to be Senior Sister Xiaoqian. A distinguished guest is here. Please come in!" Seeing this peerless beauty, Wu Randeng was immediately dazzled. With an attentive look on his face, he led her in sideways, but a cold light flashed across his eyes.
The moment he opened the door, he clearly smelled a faint smell that had the same origin as the female ghost from the night before, but it was mostly covered up by the scent of powder.
Xiaoqian walked in quickly, her eyes swept across the room, and she pretended to be surprised when she saw the wall full of books: "Junior brother is really diligent in studying, but... doesn't it feel boring to read alone in the dead of night?"
As she spoke, her fingertips lightly brushed the talisman paper on the table, and her nails were painted with kodan, glowing a coquettish red.
Wu Randeng was busy making tea, with a smile on his lips: "How can it be boring when a beauty like senior sister comes to visit, and the red sleeves add fragrance?"
Xiaoqian sneered in her heart and was secretly proud that there were no good things in men, they were all just lustful ghosts.
Men are all like this, they look sanctimonious on the surface, in fact, they are all motivated by sex.
This Wu Randeng seems to be upright, but it turns out that he can't pass the beauty test.
She lowered her eyes to hide the sarcasm in her eyes, and her voice became softer and softer: "Junior brother, thank you very much. I have a problem with talismans, and I want to ask my teacher..."
Xiaoqian took a few steps closer, and her sleeves brushed against Wu Randeng's arm, with a hint of deliberate coldness.
Wu Randeng seemed to be attracted and looked up at her with "obsessed" eyes. The teapot in his hand quietly poured more hot water into the teacup. The dense water vapor blurred the clarity that flashed through his eyes.
"Sister, please tell me," he smiled more and more "attentively", "As long as I understand, I will tell you everything."
